neighbours.label: a thing named as an emblem or symbol (state flower/bird/tree, party symbol, awareness colour)
fire: The cardinal was chosen as the official state bird of Virginia.
The donkey has long served as the symbol of the Democratic Party.
Fans wore teal ribbons to raise awareness of ovarian cancer.
The maple leaf became the national emblem of Canada.
The lotus is India's national flower and appears on many coins.
Supporters wore orange shirts in memory of residential school children.
The thistle has been the emblem of Scotland for centuries.
The giant sequoia is California's state tree.
quiet: The cardinal is a common backyard bird across Virginia.
The donkey carried supplies up the mountain trail.
Fans wore warm jackets to the evening match.
The maple leaf turned bright red in October.
The lotus grows in shallow ponds across India.
Supporters wore matching shirts to the charity run.
The thistle grows wild on the Scottish hillsides.
The giant sequoia can live for thousands of years.
